clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's reminder: a supplement is only meant to go in addition to real food, not instead of it. Even a clean label can't tell you everything - heat and irradiation during manufacturing can kill the enzymes before a product ever reaches you.

His actual instruction is simpler than any label: your mouth has teeth, your stomach doesn't. Digestion starts with chewing, not swallowing.

Kevin Trudeau's own words, half-joking but serious: chew your food.
